content_fields.title: Regularly update and patch containerization systems
content_fields.description: Keep the container runtime and orchestration components patched.
content_fields.guidance: The Docker engine, containerd, runc and the host kernel should be covered by a defined patch cadence with an emergency path for critical container-escape advisories.
content_fields.found: The repository pins application dependencies but has no influence over the container runtime version on the host.
content_fields.missing: Host patch management policy and tooling.
content_fields.conclusion: Runtime patching is host lifecycle management owned by the platform team.
content_fields.action: The platform team should include the container runtime in the host patch cadence.
